_how_it_works: Photos from local photographers, used ONLY with their permission. Every use (site, Facebook, Instagram) must show the photographer's name and link back to them. scripts/post_facebook.py rotates these into posts (see 'post' below); scripts/build_photos_page.py builds /photos.html. To add a photographer: get permission in writing first, record it under 'permission', then add their photos here.

r-marcotte.name: R. Marcotte Photography
r-marcotte.about: Landscape photographer based on Cape Cod, MA

photos.title: Nauset Light under the stars
photos.alt: Nauset Light's red and white tower lit against a starry night sky, its beam sweeping the clouds
photos.photographer_note: Shot while looking for the Milky Way and meteors at Nauset Light Beach, Cape Cod National Seashore.

photos.title: Under the Sandwich Boardwalk
photos.alt: Weathered pilings and cross-braces beneath the Sandwich Boardwalk, with marsh and water beyond
photos.photographer_note: Taken from the mud beneath the boardwalk.

photos.title: A weathered bow

photos.title: Sunset at the jetty

photos.title: Snow day
